title: AYZEN Function/Module/API Lineage Entry
description: Phase 04. One entry per ENDPOINT_REGISTRY definition (packages/endpoint-registry), reverse-traced to the Express route file/line that declares it and the lib/service module functions its handler body calls. Built by static regex-based scanning of artifacts/api-server/src/routes/*.ts -- not a full TypeScript AST parse -- so 'resolved' means a route declaration matching method+path was found, not that every function call in the handler was captured with 100% precision. See tools/lineage-builder/build.mjs's header for the heuristic's exact limits.

path.description: Full path as declared in ENDPOINT_REGISTRY, e.g. '/api/finance/books/:id'.

critical.description: auth !== 'public' -- an endpoint where knowing the owning module/function actually matters for security triage.

module.description: Route file path relative to artifacts/api-server/src/, treated as the owning module.

functions.description: Imported lib/service function names referenced inside the handler body span (heuristic identifier scan, not a call graph).

reason.description: Present only when status is 'unresolved' -- why no static route declaration matched.
